enchantSummary.forbidden: safenchant<0 or sealed bless>=128; accessory greater==3 is not enchantable
enchantSummary.weaponArmorMaximum: No hard +12 cap in normal ScrollEnchantWeapon/Armor
enchantSummary.safe: current<effectiveSafe => success; effectiveSafe=baseSafe + positive extreme-item chant modifier
enchantSummary.normalSuccess: rnd=randInt(1,100). tmp=max(1,current+(baseSafe==0?(weapon?6:armor?2:0):0)); accessory uses max(1,current). chance=truncate((100+tmp*configuredRate)/(current>=9?tmp*2:tmp)); success iff rnd<chance. Weapon scroll44066/armor44065 double chance. Above+9 failed success roll but rnd<2*chance ->delta0 no destruction.
enchantSummary.cursedDelta: bless2/130=>-1 for targetbless<3; when current>-6 delta<=0 forces success. Weapon cursed also attrEnchantLevel-1 if>=1. Below-6 destruction.
enchantSummary.failure: delete whole equipment instance; if protection active: decrease enchant1 and consume protection; renowned/artisan/talented scrolls have separate failure2 preserves item
enchantSummary.armorGrowth: Armor uses AC base-enchant (positive lowers AC). Extra MR/SP/HP/HIT/DR maps in L1ItemPower, some thresholds +3/+5/+7/+9. Accessories use greater0/1/2 tiers (data below). SQL additional enchant tables apply on itemID and enchant-safe, including itemID=0 global row.

missingMechanismsRequired: NPC size small/large choice, NPC undead/hard/damageReduction flags
bow arrows/gauntlet stings consumption; arrow graphics
actual INT, trueSP, baseINT, originalMagicHit in skill formula
movement and range/heading for binding/AOE and ranged reflection
PVP PC targets and safe zones for explicit PVP-only effects
periodic skill queue with BEINGLICKING nonstack lock
equipment blessing/seal/durability, per-instance protection and element state
polymorph/visual set effects; same ring2 rules; subclass per-slot last-wins state assignment

elementSummary.normalAddDamage: stage1..5 maps1,3,5,7,9; element kinds1earth2fire4water8wind; subtract resistance via int(.16*abs(resist))*sign/32.0 then truncate damage
elementSummary.databaseDIY: 屬性武器diy系統55rows; keykind*100+stage; extra melee/bow stats plus proc probability nextInt1000 <= probability; can root,healMP/HP, damageMultiplier,AOE,lightDamage,status,depolymorph/remove weapon/armor/doll. See L1AttackPower fullsource.
elementSummary.scroll2: AttrWeaponScroll2 uses DB chance and can downgrade element stage on failure; changing kind resets stage0. No +9/10/11 cap: those checks are commented. Scroll3 examine exactsource; direct topstage scroll unconditionally assigns its configuredkind/stage.
elementSummary.sourceQuirks: calcAttrEnchantDmg contains erroneous null-arrow branch and >= itemID comparisons causing chained projectile replacement/consumption; isolate/report instead of silently claiming corrected behavior equals source.

armorPassiveSummary.ElitePlateMail_Antharas: Adds venom immunity counter1; Venom_Resist same counter. Counter prevents source poison infection.
armorPassiveSummary.ElitePlateMail_Fafurion: receiveDamage: nextInt1000<r => draw inclusive[min,max] heal added to final HP after damage; gfx2187. Independent roll unless earlier reflection returned.
armorPassiveSummary.ElitePlateMail_Lindvior: receiveDamage: nextInt1000<r => draw inclusive[min,max] restoreMP immediately; gfx2188.
armorPassiveSummary.ElitePlateMail_Valakas: Within !isCounterBarrier, only incoming physical and non-shortdistance attacker: nextInt1000<r reflect inclusive[min,max]; halve if attacker immune; gfx10419; return BEFORE applying incoming damage (avoids hit).
armorPassiveSummary.Hades_Cloak: Within !isCounterBarrier: nextInt1000<r reflect inclusive[min,max] to attacker (magic/physical eligible); halve attackerimmune; gfx10710; return BEFORE applying incoming damage.
armorPassiveSummary.Hexagram_Magic_Rune: receiveDamage nextInt1000<r inclusive[min,max] heal and gfx; overwrites earlier addhp (Fafurion) rather than stacks.
armorPassiveSummary.DimiterBlessRune: receiveDamage separate r2/1000 chance grant IMMUNE_TO_HARM time seconds only if absent gfx11101; r/1000 MP restoration inclusive[min,max] gfx2188.
armorPassiveSummary.DimiterBlessRuneA: same immunity mechanic; second branch restores HP despite MP variable names; random1..(max-min)+min EXCLUDESmin INCLUDESmax; setCurrentHP once then addhp again in final receiveDamage => DOUBLE HP amount. Extra configured gfx. Preserve sourcequirk/report.
armorPassiveSummary.DimiterBlessRuneB: On successful physical attack: r/1000 draw min..max-1 direct damage AND casterheal, gfx11769; independent r2/1000 root4000 time seconds ifnotalreadyrooted, effectNPC86134. skill argument unused.
armorPassiveSummary.Imperius_Tshirt: On successful physicalattack: r/1000 inclusive[min,max] direct damage and equal casterheal gfx11769.
armorPassiveSummary.AttrAmulet: On successful physicalattack: r/1000 fixeddamage, halve targetimmune, configuredgfx. Separately calcAmuletAttrDmg adds5 if equipped ID402000..402007; its switch uses amulets.length constant8 => windresistance for everykind (sourcebug).
armorPassiveSummary.MoonAmulet: On successful physicalattack: r/1000 inclusive[min,max] directdamage, halve targetimmune, configuredgfx.
armorPassiveSummary.Sabot: Equip stone resist+10; damage reduction amount=args[0], threshold=min1000(args[1]+enchant*args[2]); nextInt1000<threshold reduces PC/NPC physical and PC/NPC magic, configuredgfx. Hooks named SaBot.
